title: An administrator manages users and orders: adding a user, a refused duplicate, changing and deleting the user; adding an order, changing its status and deleting it
description: An administrator logs in to the admin console with the administrator's username and password and opens the list of all users. They add a new user (username, password, gender, ID document, e-mail), then try to add a user with the already taken username fdse_microservice, and the system refuses. They change the e-mail of the new user and then delete the new user. They open the list of all orders in the system, add a new order for the passenger fdse_microservice and the contact Contacts_One on the high-speed train D1345 from shanghai to suzhou on 1 October 2026 with all fields of the order form filled in, change the status of the new order to 'Paid' and finally delete the new order.

steps.action: Log in to the admin console with the administrator's username and password
Open the list of all users
Add a new user (username, password, gender, ID document, e-mail)
Try to add a user with the already taken username fdse_microservice (the system refuses: the user already exists)
Change the e-mail of the new user
Open the list of all orders in the system
Add a new order for the passenger fdse_microservice and the contact Contacts_One on the high-speed train D1345 from shanghai to suzhou on 1 October 2026 (all fields of the order form are filled in)
Change the status of the new order to 'Paid'
